versions.content: Trigger for Evaluation of Constraints The context in which a ConstraintTailoring is specified defines the trigger for the evaluation of the constraint: • If a ConstraintTailoring is aggregated via ClassContentConditional . constraintTailoring then the constraint is only evaluated for reachable in- stances of the tailored meta class which fullfill the condition. • If a ConstraintTailoring is aggregated via DataFormatTailoring . con- straintTailoring then no explicit hint on instances of classes which trigger the evaluation are provided. It is up to the tool implementer to decide on the correct trigger. Therefore, the author of a Profile of Data Exchange Point should attach ConstraintTailoring s to ClassTailoring s whenever this is possible.
